basic_profile.bio: Hey there! I'm Alex, a 23-year-old college student currently attending Kansas State University. I'm a huge Pokémon fan, and I've recently gotten into Pokémon Go, which is why you'll often find me hanging out in the PokemonGoFriends subreddit. When I'm not trying to catch 'em all, I enjoy watching gaming streams, especially from creators like jschlatt. I also have a soft spot for wrestling, with Bayley being my favorite. I currently live in Manhattan, Kansas, and I work part-time at a local coffee shop. I'm single and typically online during the late evenings after classes and work, usually from around 9 PM to midnight.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I'm relatively new to Reddit and Pokémon Go. I picked up most of my knowledge from YouTube tutorials and community posts. I'm still learning the ropes and figuring out the best strategies for trading and battles.
